title: How to Cancel Perplexity Pro — Step-by-Step Guide (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Perplexity Pro subscription in 60 seconds. Downgrade to the free tier and keep your search history. Step-by-step.
intro: Perplexity Pro cancellation is done through your account settings and takes about a minute. The free tier still offers useful AI search — you just get fewer Pro searches per day.

steps.title: Go to Perplexity settings
steps.text: Visit perplexity.ai/settings/subscription while signed in. Or click your profile icon → Settings → Subscription.

steps.title: Click "Manage Subscription" or "Cancel"
steps.text: Find the subscription management section and click "Manage Subscription" or "Cancel Plan".

steps.title: Confirm cancellation
steps.text: Click through any confirmation dialogs. Your Pro features (unlimited Pro searches, file upload, API credits) remain active until the end of your billing period.
steps.tip: The free tier still gives you 5 Pro searches per day — often enough for casual use.

warnings: If you subscribed through Apple App Store, cancel through iOS Settings → Subscriptions.
Free tier limits you to 5 Pro searches per day (vs unlimited on Pro).
Your search history, Collections, and saved threads are preserved on the free plan.
API access is revoked after cancellation unless you have separate API credits.

faqs.q: What do I lose when canceling Perplexity Pro?
faqs.a: You lose unlimited Pro searches (drops to 5/day), file/image upload for analysis, higher model access, and API credits. Basic search still works fine.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund from Perplexity?
faqs.a: Contact Perplexity support for refund requests. They handle these case-by-case. Apple/Google subscriptions must be refunded through those platforms.
Yes. Free Perplexity gives you unlimited basic searches and 5 Pro searches per day. For most casual research needs, the free tier works well.

faqs.q: Will I lose my search history?
faqs.a: No. All your threads, Collections, and search history are preserved on the free tier.

refund.details: Contact Perplexity support for refund requests. They typically handle recent charges on a case-by-case basis.

retentionTactics: Perplexity may offer a discounted annual rate.
They'll show your usage stats and how many Pro searches you've used.
